author: Disney
description:
Watch now on @Disney+ and go behind the scenes with Walt Disney Animation Studios and Deaf West Theatre to learn how three musical numbers from Disney Animation films – “The Next Right Thing” (“Frozen 2”), “We Don’t Talk About Bruno” (“Encanto”), and “Beyond” (“Moana 2”) – were reimagined in American Sign Language.
